baselinePeriod: Pre-change baseline from available sparse evidence snapshot captured by 2026-08-25, with current measured signals at 0 and no comparable historical traffic baseline available.
qualificationRequirements: Manual change only: revise one listing element at a time, starting with headline copy only.
Keep app behavior, pricing, category, screenshots, setup documentation, support links, and privacy links unchanged during the first test window.
Record the exact before-and-after headline text and the calendar date/time when the manual listing change goes live.
Use a fixed observation window after the change that is long enough to capture at least some listing traffic; if traffic remains at zero throughout the window, the result is not qualifying evidence.
Treat any improvement as exploratory unless it is accompanied by more qualified app opens and at least one scan start.
Do not attribute any movement to the headline test if other marketplace-facing changes occur during the same observation window.
If later instrumentation allows, segment for qualified traffic where possible so low-intent opens are not mistaken for better discovery match.
Human approval and manual marketplace edit are required before measurement.
Later evidence must be compared as exploratory and low confidence.
expectedSupportingSignal: After a manual headline-only revision that makes catalog-audit audience fit clearer while preserving the existing pricing proof point, app_opened_count should increase first, followed by scan_started_count. A stronger supporting signal is more app opens with at least one resulting scan start and no corresponding rise in scan_failed_count.
expectedWeakeningSignal: Little or no change in app_opened_count and scan_started_count after the headline-only test window, or more opens without any scan starts, would weaken the discovery-clarity hypothesis and make trust or post-open friction more plausible competing explanations.
inconclusiveCondition: The test is inconclusive if marketplace traffic remains effectively zero, if measurement remains unavailable or too sparse to observe pre/post differences, or if multiple listing elements are changed during the same period so the effect cannot be isolated.
contextToMonitor: Whether the listing still shows 0 reviews during the test window, because trust friction may suppress opens or starts independently of discovery wording.
Whether read-only safety messaging remains absent near the access-risk context, because that could limit conversion from open to scan even if discovery improves.
Any Shopify App Store seasonality, placement shifts, or external promotion that could change exposure independently of the tested headline.
Whether the current title, category, screenshots, pricing label, and setup documentation remain unchanged so the test stays interpretable.
Any qualitative owner notes about merchant reactions or support questions after the copy change, especially questions about safety, access, or what happens after install.
